issues.issue: A nonoperating loss is entered as a negative sale-of-assets receipt so that receipts tie to operating + net nonoperating. The arithmetic is right, but it could also be treated as an expense or as negative other_financing.

issues.on_page: Special items: Casualty loss income - storm damage 101,231
issues.issue: The cash flow statement (p3) calls this 'Insurance proceeds - storm damages'. Recording it as an adjustment (special item) is defensible, but it could also be a reimbursements/refunds receipt.
